sloka: शासनेन तु रामस्य लक्ष्मणः सविभीषणः ।द्वारे द्वारे हरीणां तु कोटिं कोटिं न्यवेशयत् ।। ६.४१.४२ ।।।।
transliteration: śāsanena tu rāmasya lakṣmaṇaḥ savibhīṣaṇaḥ ।dvāre dvāre harīṇāṁ tu koṭiṁ koṭiṁ nyaveśayat ।। 6.41.42 ।।।।

translations.english: Renowned generals of the Vanara army and thirtysix crores of Vanaras stood there camping.
